text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After spending a day out with Taiki
Shuttle, I take
a breather in my office.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Let's go home together!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We're not done hangin' out till I'm back
at my
dorm! There's still more fun to be
had!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh... I guess that comes first.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Aww...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've got it! I'll just wait till you're
done!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You go ahead and work as much as ya
like!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's no problem at all! I'll be real
quiet, so as
not to disturb ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's completely dark outside by the time
I wrap up
the last of my work.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mornin', Trainer! See, you could barely
tell I was
here!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mornin', Trainer! See, you could barely
tell I was
here!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What're ya talkin' about? Watchin' ya
work was
plenty fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Though I did take a moment to rest my
eyeballs!
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer! That ain't no way to speak
to a
lady!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But I tell ya what. Walk me back to my
dorm, and
I'll let ya off. ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, all right! Thanks a ton, my dear
trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This can be my reward for keepin' ya
company.
Heck, I can wait all day if this
kinda happiness is
at the end of the
road. ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna walk real slow, so let's chat it
up like
there's no tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle chatters happily with me all
the way
back, her face beaming with joy.
